answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 40849 Country: United Kingdom Title: islamic name Question: Currently we are expecting our third child, Alhamdulillah. Allah blessed us with two boys earlier and we named them Mohammed and Zakir. My wife was thinking to keep the name Aaisa, Maryam or Fatima in case it is a girl and Ahmad, Adam or Ibrahim in case it is a boy. Could you please help us in deciding which will be better? May Allah accept all your work you are doing! Please remember me in your dua also make dua for my wife as she is in last stage of her pregnancy. Answer ID: 40849 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1318/1318/M=1433) The names Asiya, Maryam and Fatima for girl and Ahmad, Adam and Ibrahim for boy are very nice and blessed ones. You may choose any name amongst them. We recommend you to keep the name Ahmad in case it is a boy and Fatimah in case it is a girl. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
